“Sino kayo?" The woman who cried wolf. 

If their decision is not important, then why bother at all? But for me the senate decision is important in his case because the Senate represents part of the sovereign authority of the Philippines.

 It strengthens the narrative that the country stands behind him and views the detention as unjust or politically motivated.
